name: Pipeliners - Position 8-20 Keywords 2026-10-03
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-10-03

# Summary
A keyword list (`pipeliners-keywords-position-8-20.csv`, about 254 rows) of every Pipeliners query sitting at average position 8 to 20 in GSC as of Oct 3, 2026, with the ranking URL, clicks, impressions and a flag column. `raw.txt` holds the same data unformatted.

# Key findings
- Almost every row has 0 clicks.
- Top rows: "florence pipe break repair" (/florence/, 97 impressions at 10.4), "buckeye az pipe break repair" (/buckeye/, 82 at 12.7), "drain cleaning mesa az" (GBP link, 64 at 8.2), "buckeye az water line repair" (54 at 15.9).
- Flags: rows landing on the GBP website link are marked "GBP is read-only"; "buckeye gas line repair" is marked "Not offered (gas lines)".
- City pages dominate: Florence, Buckeye, Apache Junction, Fountain Hills, Sun Lakes, Queen Creek, Fort McDowell, Maricopa.
